harness_rev_note: RE-RECORDED 2026-09-06 (oracle-phase0 golden pass): 34 cells, taken from a FULL record.sh --plane all of the SAME published 1.5.5 binary (48e2800c...) under harness_rev 44b21569; the other 862 cells are untouched and still reflect harness_rev 1083031798 (now in harness_rev_history). WHY THESE 34: 33 moved because the HARNESS CONFIG changed, not the binary. f5d0b0bb added the sibling budget group broke-quota, a fourth minted key (oracle-quota) and a second per-boot priming request to oracle-config.sh/record.sh, which (i) shifted every config.yaml line number by +4, moving the 'at line N column M' suffix of 14 --validate refusals (boot.refusal BOOT-P01/P12/P13/P14/P31/P32/P33-P40 validate; neutrality NEUT-U-top/models/providers validate), (ii) added the group:broke-quota@day bucket rows to /metrics (ops.scrape metrics key; crosscut.traps request-duration-quantiles), (iii) counted one more request on lane 6 in /stats (ops.scrape stats key; neutrality routes stats; neutrality stats-idle-zero; documented changelog stats-reasons; http.crosscut bearer-and-x-api-key), and (iv) added the fourth key, the third group and one audit row to the admin views (admin.ops GetKeys ok, GetGroups ok, GetPools ok, GetPoolsName ok, GetUsage ok, GetUsage no-usage-after-mutation, GetAudit ok; billing admin-usage after-2 and past-day). The 34th, plugins.store-persist store-sqlite, moved because d769a714 gave record.sh the exec.paths strip the exec driver already had: its old cell quoted the CI runner's own absolute recording paths back into its effects, so the norm-rule set carried exec.paths on one side only. No cell was edited by hand and no cell was recorded from anything but the published 1.5.5 binary. WHY FROM A FULL RUN, NOT A --filter RUN: a cell whose answer depends on state earlier cells left (the governance store, the metrics buckets) records DIFFERENTLY under a filter -- a filtered re-record of ops.scrape metrics key carried a group:oracle-added@day bucket that no full run has at that point -- so these came out of a full --plane all pass and were verified stable across two independent full 1.5.5 runs. TWO CELLS WERE DELIBERATELY NOT RE-RECORDED: documented readme tls-mtls and neutrality boot-lines differ between two full runs of the SAME binary by one boot-log line, '[info] removed 1 orphaned plugin staging dir(s) left by a crashed prior run' -- leftover state in the recorder's own tree, not behaviour. Their checked-in cells (the no-leftover form) stand. The recorded count also corrects a stale 885 that was never bumped as cells were added: the golden holds 896 PASS cells and now says so. | Earlier note: 6 cells added (oracle Phase 0, group-BUDGET-total arm): a new sibling group `broke-quota` (budget cap ONLY, no requests cap) and its QUOTA key/priming request in oracle-config.sh/record.sh, plus the new `over_budget_total` outcome enumerated in enumerate-cells.py, changed the harness revision. Recorded fresh from the SAME golden binary (48e2800c...) against the current tree: llm|<dialect>|<dialect>|request|over_budget_total for all six dialects. The other 885 cells are untouched and still reflect their own harness_rev_recorded/prior harness_rev. | Earlier note: RE-STAMPED 2026-09-05 (round-3 audit), NO cell re-recorded and no cell's bytes changed — `recorded`, `at` and every cells/*.json are exactly as they were under harness_rev 028cb0d2 (now the last entry of harness_rev_history). Three harness changes moved the hash: (1) harness-rev.sh's own file set gained apply-mutation.py and scripts/*.py (scripts/apply-deferred-decisions.py) — both decide what an exec/script cell is recorded against, and neither was in the revision that names how a recording was made; (2) cells.json grew 10 SKIP-able cell DEFINITIONS the round-3 audit named (six llm|<d>|<d>|request|stream_upstream_error, billing|key-usage|refund-across-window, http.crosscut|413|{mcp-streamable-http,a2a-jsonrpc,gemini-path}) — definitions only, all needs_fixture except the gemini 413, none recorded here, so they read as named golden gaps until the integrator re-records from the published 1.5.5 binary; (3) mock-upstream.py gained the `stream-error` control verb those six cells need, which fires only under the control header on an already-streaming request and leaves every happy-path stream builder byte-identical. capture.py's audit-delta fix is in the hash too and is a no-op on this golden (its audit deltas are 0/1/11 — nowhere near the `?limit=1000` page the fix is about). PREVIOUS NOTE: 3 cells hand-replaced from fresh single-cell recordings against the SAME golden binary (48e2800c...) after two harness fixes: (1) scripts/documented-validate-checks.sh resolved BUSBAR_BIN and RAW to absolute paths before step4's `cd "$W/s4"` -- previously a relative --bin or --out made step4's own `busbar --validate` invocation (or its stdout/stderr redirects) fail before/without ever running busbar, which is why the old golden's step4_bare_path_exit was "1" with EMPTY stderr; the real 1.5.5 behavior is exit 0 with the BUSBAR_PROVIDERS deprecation warning, now reflected in documented|changelog|validate-checks; (2) normalize.py gained a `ts.usage-window` rule (window.start/window.end under a `window` object -> 0) so admin.ops|GetUsage|ok and admin.ops|GetUsage|no-usage-after-mutation no longer pin the UTC-day boundary the recording happened to be made on. renormalize.sh could not be used because this golden's raw/ captures are not checked in; each of the 3 cells was replaced by hand from `record.sh --filter <cell-id>` output. The other 882 cells are untouched and still reflect harness_rev_recorded.
